    <!-- MODULE 4 (EN) — WHY KALPITIYA FOR LEARNING -->
<section class="rv-wrap rv-mt-14" id="why-kalpitiya">
  <div class="rv-card rv-pad">
    <h2 class="rv-h2">Why Kalpitiya is one of the best places to learn kitesurfing in Sri Lanka</h2>
    <p class="rv-sub">
      Kalpitiya is known for calm lagoon sessions, reliable wind seasons, and a slower rhythm than crowded resort areas.
      This combination supports focused learning and steady progression, which is why many travellers choose Kalpitiya
      for their first kitesurfing lessons in Sri Lanka.
    </p>
<p class="rv-small" style="margin: 0.6rem 0 1.1rem">                                                                                          
    Sri Lanka kite trip on the cards?                    
    <a class="rv-link" href="/kitesurfing-sri-lanka">Read our complete Sri Lanka kitesurfing guide</a> for spots, seasons and what to pack.
  </p>
    <div class="rv-addon-grid rv-mt-14">
      <div class="rv-soft rv-pad">
        <h3 class="rv-h3">Flat water lagoon</h3>
        <p class="rv-sub">
          You learn faster when the water is forgiving. The shallow lagoon makes early sessions feel safer,
          more stable, and easier to control.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="rv-soft rv-pad">
        <h3 class="rv-h3">Two wind seasons</h3>
        <p class="rv-sub">
          Kalpitiya offers two main wind seasons each year. We help you choose the right dates
          to match the best learning conditions.
        </p>
        <p class="rv-note rv-mt-10">
          See wind details:
          <a href="/windguru-kalpitiya-srilanka-forecast" class="rv-link">
            Wind forecast and seasons
          </a>
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="rv-soft rv-pad">
        <h3 class="rv-h3">Space and calm</h3>
        <p class="rv-sub">
          Less rush, more focus on the basics. After your session, Ruuk Village offers a calm place
          to rest, reflect, and recharge.
        </p>
      </div>

<section class="rv-wrap rv-mt-14" id="ruuk-way">
  <div class="rv-card rv-pad">
    <h2 class="rv-h2">Kite teaching in Kalpitiya with safety-first coaching</h2>
    <p class="rv-sub">
      Kalpitiya offers ideal lagoon conditions for learning, but real progress comes from the right guidance.
      Our kite teaching in Kalpitiya is calm, structured, and safety-first, helping beginners and progressing riders
      build confidence step by step.
    </p>
    <div class="rv-addon-grid rv-mt-14">
      <div class="rv-soft rv-pad">

      </div>
      <div class="rv-soft rv-pad">
        <h3 class="rv-h3">Quality over volume</h3>
        <p class="rv-sub">We keep it personal. You are not one of many. Your progress stays the priority.</p>

    <!-- MODULE 8 (EN) — FAQ -->
<section class="rv-wrap rv-mt-14" id="faq">
  <div class="rv-card rv-pad">
    <h2 class="rv-h2">Kite lessons in Sri Lanka FAQ</h2>
    <p class="rv-sub">
      Quick answers to common questions. If you share your dates and level, we reply with a tailored plan.
    </p>
    <div class="rv-faq rv-mt-14">
      <details class="rv-faq-item" open>
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">Is Kalpitiya good for beginners?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Yes. The flat water lagoon makes early sessions feel more stable. It is a strong place to build confidence.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">Is this a certified kitesurfing school in Sri Lanka?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Our instructors are certified and follow international teaching standards. All lessons focus on safety-first coaching adapted to Kalpitiya’s local wind and lagoon conditions.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">Do you offer kite teaching in Kalpitiya for beginners?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Yes. Our kite teaching in Kalpitiya is ideal for beginners thanks to flat water lagoon conditions, small groups, and structured lesson plans that build confidence step by step.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">What is the best season for kite lessons in Sri Lanka?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Kalpitiya has two main wind seasons. Share your travel window and we will recommend the best weeks for learning and progression.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">Do I need experience to start?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          No. Many guests start from zero. We begin with safety basics, kite control, and step by step progression.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">How many days do I need to learn?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          It depends on wind, fitness, and learning speed. Many guests plan around a week to reach consistent progress.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">Is equipment included in lessons?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Lesson equipment is typically included. If you want extra independent sessions, you can also add gear rental.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">Can non-kitesurfers stay as well?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Yes. Ruuk Village also welcomes non-kitesurfers who are looking for nature, calm surroundings, and authentic Sri Lanka.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">Is Ruuk Village a polished resort?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Not a classic resort. Ruuk Village is a nature-led, community-run place - simple, calm, and close to the lagoon and coconut trees.
          Wildlife is part of daily life here, so we recommend keeping food and small personal items stored safely inside your cabana.
        </div>
      </details>
      <details class="rv-faq-item">
        <summary class="rv-faq-q">How do I get to Ruuk Village?</summary>
        <div class="rv-faq-body">
          Most guests arrive via Colombo airport. We can arrange a direct airport pickup to Kalpitiya on request.
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
    <p class="rv-note rv-mt-12">
      Want wind details? See:
      <a href="/windguru-kalpitiya-srilanka-forecast" class="rv-link">Kalpitiya wind forecast</a>
    </p>
